title: When Harry Met Sally...
score_note: 29 — ties Always Be My Maybe at the top of the table

beats.name: THE DRIVE TO CHICAGO
cap: eighteen hours to Chicago; he says men
and women can never be friends
beats.tag: MEET-CUTE — an argument, not a courtship

beats.name: THE FLIGHT
cap: five years on, a flight; she has a man,
he has a wife; the argument resumes
beats.tag: SECOND MEETING — still no common ground

beats.name: THE BOOKSTORE
cap: six years later both are newly single;
the argument finally turns companionable
beats.tag: THIRD MEETING — the argument becomes company

beats.name: THE FRIENDSHIP
cap: they talk on the phone, split the check,
walk, and say they are just friends

beats.name: THE DELI
cap: at the deli, she fakes an orgasm to prove
he would not know the difference
beats.tag: THE ROUTINE — the scene everyone quotes

beats.name: THE SET-UP DINNER
cap: they set each other up; Jess and Marie
fall for each other before the entree
beats.tag: THE SET-UP — the friends find each other

beats.name: THE WEDDING
cap: Jess and Marie marry; Harry and Sally
dance and keep insisting they are friends
beats.tag: THE WEDDING — everyone paired but them

beats.name: THE NIGHT TOGETHER
cap: she hears her ex is marrying; she calls
Harry; they cry, then sleep together
beats.tag: THE TURN — the friendship breaks its own rule

beats.name: THE MORNING AFTER
cap: in the morning he calls it a mistake;
she slaps him and they stop speaking
beats.tag: BREAKUP — it flows from who he is

beats.name: THE SILENCE
cap: months pass; the married friends are
caught between them and take sides
beats.tag: THE STRETCH — nothing said, everything felt

beats.name: NEW YEAR'S EVE
cap: at midnight he lists everything he loves
about her and wants the rest of his life
beats.tag: THE GESTURE — the speech that ends the film
